verdicts.decision_note: The client identifies an implementation-relevant PCB routing rule requiring at least 1 mm power stubs for VBUS, +5V, and BAT-.
First concrete design-review failure: several specified power stubs measure only 0.2–0.6 mm instead of at least 1 mm.

The client replaces the blanket stub-width rule with concrete PCB acceptance conditions for continuous VBUS and BAT− copper paths, absence of thin series bottlenecks, and sufficient interlayer via stitching at the stated worst-case current.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer states that the battery-trace path can carry 2.5 A, but reports no executed test supporting runtime verification.
